journey.name: repay paid invoice
journey.description: Paying again a Lightning invoice this wallet already paid sends nothing: the second swipe opens the Success sheet of the earlier payment with the amount it sent, also when the repeat typed another amount for an amountless invoice. An invoice sharing the payment hash of another paid invoice is refused as already paid; that case needs a payee that reuses a payment hash and is covered by AppViewModelSendFlowTest. Precondition: onboarded dev wallet with at least 10 000 sats in Spark, QuickPay off, and an amountless Lightning invoice from another node (for example `./spark invoice` on the bitkit-docker Spark stack), handed to the app as a deep link. The Success sheet's own tag ("SendSuccess") sits on a wrapper `android layout` leaves out, so the steps check its Close button. Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Record the spending balance; run `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "lightning:<invoice>" to.bitkit.dev`
Enter 1 000 sats, continue to the Confirm screen (tag "SendConfirm") and swipe to pay
Verify the Success sheet opens within 30 seconds showing 1 000 sats, with its Close button (tag "Close"); tap Close and verify the spending balance is lower by about 1 000 sats
Run the same `adb shell am start … "lightning:<invoice>" …` command again with the same invoice
Enter 2 000 sats, continue to the Confirm screen (tag "SendConfirm") and swipe to pay
Verify the Success sheet opens showing 1 000 sats, not 2 000
Tap Close and verify the spending balance did not drop a second time, and the home activity list shows one Sent row for this invoice
